heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: There are authorized to be appropriated to carry out sections 5136 to 5143 of this title $8,000,000 for each of the fiscal years 1991 through 1995.

notes.text: Codification Another section 6 of Pub. L. 91–229 was added by Pub. L. 101–82, title III, § 303, Aug. 14, 1989, 103 Stat. 583, and is classified to section 5142 of this title. Section was formerly classified to section 494 of this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
